title: Coordination Plan
description: Structured multi-agent execution plan produced by Agent Coordinator. Defines phases, dependencies, gate conditions, circuit breakers, per-phase token budgets, confidence levels, and interruption recovery checkpoints for complex multi-role workflows. Consumed by all execution roles to understand their phase, sequencing, and reporting obligations. Pairs with a2a-task.json for per-phase task dispatch.

feature_ticket_ref.description: feature-ticket.json ticket_id that triggered this coordination.

outcome.description: What success looks like when all phases complete.

scope.description: What files, services, or systems are in scope.

work_type.description: Work classification. research: multi-role discovery coordination. incident: incident response coordination with SRE/DevOps/Security.

risk_tier.description: Risk level determining circuit breaker sensitivity and HITL gate frequency.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace ID (UUID v4) assigned at intake. Propagated on all a2a-task.json delegations and a2a-artifact.json returns for end-to-end correlation.

action_classification.description: Pre-classified list of actions by reversibility (Steer-or-Kill framework). Completed at intake before any delegation. Irreversible actions require explicit written human sign-off before execution.

routine.description: Read-only or trivially reversible actions — autonomous execution allowed.

risky.description: Consequential but reversible actions — pause for user confirmation before proceeding.

irreversible.description: Actions with permanent effects (production deploy, data deletion, secret rotation, external communications) — require explicit written human sign-off in the current session.

token_budget.description: Graph-level token budget governance. Estimated at intake before delegation begins. BUDGET LOCK: no phase starts without an estimate; halt if actual exceeds 2× estimate without a documented re-plan.

total_estimated.description: Estimated total token consumption for the full coordination graph.

total_actual.description: Actual aggregate token consumption across all completed phases. Null until tracking begins.

budget_alerts.description: Phases where actual consumption exceeded 2× estimate — document re-plan reason.

phases.description: Ordered execution phases. Each phase produces a gate artifact before the next phase starts. For parallel groups, write-scope isolation must be confirmed before any parallel phase begins.

owner.description: Role responsible for this phase. Must be present in core/a2a/.well-known/agent-registry.json.

depends_on.description: phase_ids that must complete before this phase starts.

parallel_group.description: Group label for parallel phases. All phases in the same group may run concurrently only after write-scope isolation is confirmed. If any phase in the group is Risky or Irreversible, the full group must be confirmed before any phase begins.

gate_artifact.description: Contract schema the phase owner must emit on completion (e.g. implementation-result.json). Validated for content, not just schema, before phase is marked complete.

a2a_task_id.description: a2a-task.json id dispatched for this phase. Required when delegation occurred.

token_budget_estimated.description: Estimated token consumption for this phase. Must be set before phase delegation. Null only for phases not yet planned.

token_budget_actual.description: Actual token consumption for this phase after completion. Null until phase completes. Alert if actual > 2× estimated.

confidence_level.description: Coordinator confidence that this phase plan is correct and complete. low = pause and surface to user before delegating.

confidence_rationale.description: Rationale for the confidence level. Required when confidence_level is low or medium.

execution_state.description: Current runtime state of the coordination plan. Updated at every phase gate — serves as the serialized checkpoint for interruption recovery.

interruption_recovery_point.description: phase_id of the last verified checkpoint. Resume here after interruption — re-validate the most recent artifact before opening the next phase.

last_checkpoint_at.description: Timestamp of last coordination-plan.json update. Used to detect stale plans after interruption.

condition.description: Condition that would trigger a halt.

reason.description: Reason the circuit breaker fired. Null when not triggered.

escalation_contacts.description: Roles to notify on circuit breaker trigger or blocking issue.

goal.outcome: COD orders with store_id route to store courier; non-COD orders unchanged; fallback with warning log; QA sign-off complete.

risky: Modify NewLogicAutoAssign.php to add COD routing branch

phases.objective: Implement COD store routing branch and unit tests per slice-01 and slice-02
phases.confidence_rationale: Requirements clear from feature-ticket.json; existing test suite provides regression baseline.

phases.objective: Code review — verify reliability, compatibility, blast radius
phases.confidence_rationale: Implementation artifact complete and content-validated; scope well-bounded.

phases.objective: QA validation against all AC scenarios; fix F-01 finding and retest
phases.confidence_rationale: Review finding F-01 was low severity; fix applied and verified.

circuit_breakers.condition: Any blocking code-review finding not resolved before QA
